title: The senses differ by their laws of sensorimotor contingency

statements.text: The sensory modalities are constituted by distinct patterns of sensorimotor contingency, not by an intrinsic property of the nerve pathways that carry them, so no specific nerve energy is needed to explain why seeing differs from hearing.

sources.quote: The sensory modalities, according to the present proposal, are constituted by distinct patterns of sensorimotor contingency.
